svg.title: Three plots on the interval [0,1]: (a) the output of one sigmoid neuron with large weight, a sharp step at s = 0.4, with a gentler sigmoid dashed for comparison; (b) two neurons with steps at 0.4 and 0.6 and output weights 0.8 and −0.8, giving a bump of height 0.8 on [0.4, 0.6]; (c) five such pairs giving a step function with heights 0.3, −1.3, −0.4, −1.3, 1.1 on the intervals of length 0.2.
